algorithm.q0: Efforts4..6 can reuse private converted planes for full-frame coefficient statistics, without Y2. Cache reservation120*blocks+16384; conservative local work/memory envelope and actual charges preserved. Exact prediction/reconstructed pixels.
algorithm.alpha: Compare the existing horizontal fixed prefix/run plan with an independently implemented adaptive green/distance plan and four recent positions per three-residual hash. Maximum copy4096, bounded history65536positions, special previous-pixel/row distances and generic RFC9649 distances. Count complete padded ALPH bytes and retain the smaller candidate; require it to beat raw.
algorithm.localWorkEnvelope: 96*N+5,200,000 covers fixed count, histogram/count/write match passes, bounded table construction and history resets. At most four candidates, each no longer than the selected maximum that is consumed: <=12 comparisons/sample/pass; hash/update/writer charges fit remaining margin. Green280/distance40 alphabets bound builder work; every actual charge is retained.
algorithm.admission: Choose from local allowances before allocation, reserve owned capacities through same borrowed root. No shared-refusal/work/cancellation fallback. Dispose unselected successful candidates promptly and keep selected history/tables charged through actual writing.
